title: Kagamine Len — In Her Time Of Need〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Stopped Hand Moves Once More

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's happening soon, right...?
Mafuyu's gonna finally talk to her mom.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-Is she gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't know.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But Kanade's with her.
And there's no point in us worrying...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin's been tugging on her sleeve for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think she's actually really worried...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What are you two whispering about?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't we try finding Luka and the others, and we can have a chat?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah.
We're just gonna get more and more anxious if we keep thinking about this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't think talking to them is going to fix that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it might help take our mind off of things...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you like to come with us, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: ...Which is why you three came looking for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, MEIKO, how do you feel about Mafuyu going over to talk to her mom?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe it's necessary.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mafuyu's family is a big reason why she is the way she is now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If Mafuyu is resolved to face that, then we should sit back and believe in her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
It is her decision.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You all seem worried.

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line: We are...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't think there's any point in worrying.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She is on my mind, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's perfect, then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's go find Luka and KAITO.
There's something I need to say to them.
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you all want?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're here to make a statement.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Mafuyu is at a crossroads right now.
We'd like for you to sit back and watch how things unfold.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You came all this way just to tell me that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
We're really worried about Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But we feel the same as MEIKO. We don't want you to do anything unnecessary.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You should be telling her that, instead of me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How mean, KAITO.
I just wanted to sneak up right next to them and say, “Boo!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmph...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you really are no fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, Luka...
We...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're here about Mafuyu, yes?
I overheard a bit of your conversation just now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm very much looking forward to seeing how things unfold.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're not worried?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, not nearly as much as the rest of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I can't wait to see what happens.
I mean, the wheels are finally starting to turn after being at a standstill for so long.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're amazing, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is that really something to be amazed by?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If we keep worrying, then that's just gonna make Mafuyu feel worse, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Instead, we should support her, so she feels ready to talk to her mom.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All the more reason not to put on that sorry excuse for a brave face. You know how perceptive she is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. She'll likely feel better if you act the way you normally do, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I also agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Looks like all we can do is pray that things go well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please make it so Mafuyu's mom understands what her daughter has to say...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Please...
